scope: one temporary read-only PostgreSQL connection from local workstation; five serial SELECT 1 observations maximum
execution_origin: local workstation, not Cloud Run or Vercel
hostname_region_semantics: Inference from configured hostname only; not an independently verified database deployment region.
limitations: Single connection and at most five observations; no percentile, causal attribution, load or migration-duration conclusion.
Local client network includes distance to the database and cannot substitute for Cloud Run-to-database measurements.
Connection time includes client/DNS/TCP/TLS/provider factors; provider wake-up is not separately measured.
region_comparison: API configured region and database hostname region hint differ; Cloud Run-to-database latency was not measured.

queries: service.catalog queries the same User again
employer_catalog.avoidable_roundtrip: The second User query does not refresh the shared cached identity. A future read-only catalog can use its already authenticated User while preserving the owner boundary.

public_billing_catalog.work: Environment/catalog construction; no database dependency or SQL in the handler.

authenticated_billing_config.work: Authentication User read; handler otherwise uses the same static catalog construction.

catalog_static_analysis.counts_scope: Source-level explicit SELECT counts, not runtime tracing. Pool pre-ping, transaction setup/rollback, connection establishment and proxy/network hops can add work.
catalog_static_analysis.client_hop: Frontend same-origin BFF forwards an uncached backend request; no additional production catalog request was made.

prior_observations_supplied_by_release_o.comparability: Prior catalog/migration observations have different origin and workload from these local SELECT 1 samples.

next_diagnostic_recommendation: Measure bounded connection and SQL timings from the deployed API region separately from BFF/network time before attributing latency; retain current GCP/Vercel/Neon topology.
